name: Slovenia
work_strategy: Remote / Hybrid (Normirani s.p. — 4% effective tax up to a certain threshold)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; then 16–50% PIT + social contributions; Ukrainian 5% single tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: Temperate / Alpine (Warm summers, snowy winters, short sea coastline)
nature: Top Nature (Julian Alps, Lake Bled, Bohinj, emerald Soča River, Adriatic coast at Piran)
english_level: Good (High English proficiency; Slovenian is a Slavic language)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Any document proving citizenship. Police registration within 3 days.
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Temporary protection (1 year, renewable). An EMŠO number is assigned.
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **From 31.07.2026, EU countries do not grant protection to conscription-liable persons without proof of legal exit and deferral.**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: Pocket money 125 €/mo in centers; rent allowance from 125 to 420 € per month (depending on family size).
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: Reception center in Logatec. Hard to rent, though state rent subsidy is available.
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Mandatory basic insurance covers emergency care and checkups; completely free for children under 18.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: Since 01.01.2024, all public transport is paid.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Automatic right to work with TP card. Demand for engineers, IT specialists, and blue-collar workers.
